    "WCB015_TAS102": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB027_Cap": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB027_XELOX": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB041_Cap": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB041_FOLFIRI_Bev": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB087_5FU": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB091_FOLFOX_Bev": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB123_FOLFOX": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB123_FOLFOXIRI": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB139_5FU_Bev": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB139_TAS102": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB146_5FU_Bev": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB150_5FU_Bev_1": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB150_FOLFIRI": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB150_TAS102": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB203_Cap_Bev": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB203_Iri": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB217_TAS102": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB221_FOLFOX": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB239_FOLFOX_Bev": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB239_FOLFIRI_Cet": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB242_FOLFIRI_Pani": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB245_FOLFOX_Cet": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB254_FOLFOXIRI": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB254_FOLFOX_Cet": {"patient_response": "Good response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Sensitive"},
    "WCB291_5FU_Bev": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
    "WCB296_FOLFOXIRI": {"patient_response": "Poor response", "pdto_chemo_pred": "Resistant"},
}

records = []
for rid, v in vision_data.items():
    pred = v["pdto_chemo_pred"]
    outcome = v["patient_response"]
    
    # Map prediction: Sensitive=1, Resistant=0
    if pred == "Sensitive":
        score = 1
    elif pred == "Resistant":
        score = 0
    else:
        continue
    
    # Map truth: Good response=1, Poor response=0
    if outcome == "Good response":
        truth = 1
    elif outcome == "Poor response":
        truth = 0
    else:
        continue
    
    records.append({"id": rid, "score": score, "truth": truth})

n = len(records)
correct = sum(1 for r in records if r["score"] == r["truth"])
acc = correct / n if n > 0 else 0

print(f"Total records: {n}")
print(f"Correct: {correct}")
print(f"Accuracy: {acc}")
print(f"Expected: 24/29 = {24/29}")

# Verify
if n == 29 and abs(acc - 24/29) < 0.001:
    print("MATCH!")
else:
    print("MISMATCH - checking individual records")
    for r in records:
        match = "OK" if r["score"] == r["truth"] else "WRONG"
        print(f"  {r['id']}: pred={r['score']}, truth={r['truth']} -> {match}")
